meta.title: Indoor Bouldering Social Mood Board
meta.brief: A social media campaign visual world for indoor climbing gyms focused on bouldering. The mood should feel fun, joyful, welcoming, and community driven.
meta.goal: Create a visual direction for social posts that makes bouldering feel approachable, social, energetic, and worth joining.
meta.audience: New and returning indoor climbers, friend groups, students, young professionals, and community-minded gym members.
assumptions: No existing brand colors, logo, or campaign assets were provided.
Avoid extreme-risk outdoor imagery; keep the world indoor, supervised, and welcoming.
Images should work as inspiration for posts, stories, reels covers, event promos, and membership/community content.

visual_territories: Chalk, holds, shoes, and wall texture
signals.palette_direction: Clean gym neutrals with playful hold colors: coral, teal, lime, cobalt, sunny yellow, soft pink, and warm plywood.
signals.emotional_register: Fun, joyful, inclusive, active, supportive, lightly competitive, and social.
